xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3836: Deliberate project creation: clone from GitHub, resolve-before-create, remote-derived identity, /projects/new

plan.title: Deliberate project creation: clone from GitHub, resolve-before-create, remote-derived identity, /projects/new
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: Project creation is the thinnest flow in Overdeck and every other flow depends on it. Nothing can clone a repository from GitHub; registerProjectFromPath writes only name and path, so github_repo, tracker, default_branch and issue_prefix must be edited by hand before the pipeline can run; registration never creates the main workspace row; NewProjectModal has no resolve-before-create preview and shows errors as one ad hoc string; and the dashboard never says when to create a project versus a workspace.
narratives.Proposal: Copy the shape of src/lib/workspaces/create.ts onto projects: a shared core src/lib/projects/create.ts with resolveProjectCreateIntent (zero writes, findings per field, memoized git ls-remote probe) and performProjectCreate (spawned git clone with progress and prompt-guard env, git init, registration with detected extras, workspaces/ in .git/info/exclude, main-workspace bootstrap through the workspace core). Expose it as POST /api/projects/resolve, a 202 clone job on POST /api/projects with a pollable GET /api/projects/create-jobs/:jobId, and pan project clone / pan project add --dry-run. Replace NewProjectModal with a /projects/new page (mode tabs, status strip, inline findings, clone progress, project-versus-workspace guide) behind a no-loss audit test, then delete the modal. Update projects.mdx, WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the pan-new-project skill. All decisions D-1 to D-17 are fixed in the PRD.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No smart name field on /workspaces/new that accepts an issue id or URL and routes to pan start.
- No checked-in per-repo setup config (shared directories, setup command) like Orca's orca.yaml.
- No moving of worktrees out of <project>/workspaces/ to a central directory.
- No cloning onto a Fly remote host.
- Never edit the tracked .gitignore of a registered repository; only .git/info/exclude.
- No tests/quality_gates config detection; the pan-new-project skill keeps doing that.
- Do not refactor resolveWorkspaceRemote in src/lib/github-credentials.ts (D-16).
- No execSync anywhere under src/lib/projects/ or the dashboard routes.
- No direct SQL against the workspaces/projects tables; only the resolver and writer doors.
- No --harness or --model overrides and no hardcoded model fallbacks.

metadata.sizeJustification: The PRD (operator-authored, 17 decisions) is one strictly serial chain: core types → perform → job store → routes → hook → page → entry-point wiring with the no-loss audit → modal deletion. No prefix of that chain ships independent user value (a core with no caller, routes with no page, or a page next to the modal it replaces), so sibling issues would produce four serial pipeline runs each blocked on the previous merge with no per-run UAT target. The 32 files are the honest projection of one feature across lib, routes, CLI, frontend, tests and docs; docs and CLI items are already parallel branches of the DAG.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept PAN-3836 as one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator authored one PRD with a strictly serial dependency chain; sibling issues would add four serial pipeline runs with no independently verifiable value per run.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the core file into a resolve item (inspected, deep) and a perform item sharing src/lib/projects/create.ts with a blocks edge.
autoDecisions.rationale: The resolve types and findings contract are the foundation every later item consumes; inspecting them before perform, routes, CLI and page start prevents a MIN-796-style cascade.

autoDecisions.summary: Marked project-create-routes as the second inspected item (fast) with foundationFor the hook and page.
autoDecisions.rationale: The 202/422/409 contract and job record shape are what the frontend polls; a drift there would force the hook and page to be redone.

autoDecisions.summary: Used an informs edge, not blocks, from the routes item to the frontend hook.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD pins the request and response shapes, so the hook can be built and unit-tested against mocked fetch in parallel; the DAG still serializes the page after the hook.

autoDecisions.summary: Replaced the PRD's AC-8 clone target eltmon/overdeck-knowledge with eltmon/okf under $HOME/.overdeck/uat/pan-3836 named pan-3836-uat.
autoDecisions.rationale: overdeck-knowledge is already on disk at ~/Projects/overdeck-knowledge on the development machine, so resolve would return target-exists and the UAT could never pass.

autoDecisions.summary: Moved the rewrite of NewWorkspacePage.test.tsx:372 and NewWorkspacePage.parity.test.tsx:117-118 into the wiring item.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those cases assert the chips open the modal; without rewriting them the wiring item cannot be green before the modal-deletion item.

The PRD named tests/unit/cli/project-clone.test.ts but pointed at tests/unit/cli/commands/ for the exitCli pattern, which lives in tests/unit/cli/project-commands.test.ts; one sibling file next to it is the least ambiguous location.

autoDecisions.summary: Documentation is two items: user/dev docs plus CLAUDE.md, and the pan-new-project skill.
autoDecisions.rationale: The skill edit needs pan sync and a distinct verification, so it is independently reviewable; both run in parallel with the frontend chain.

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-7: Step 2 becomes 'run `pan project clone <url>` or `pan project add <path>`; both detect the remote, default branch, and prefix and create the main workspace'. Step 3 drops issue_prefix, github_repo, and default_branch from the minimum config (registration writes them) and keeps tests/quality_gates. Step 4 notes parseGitHubReposSync already derives the GITHUB_REPOS entry from github_repo. Step 6 becomes optional and says workspaces/ is excluded via .git/info/exclude. Remove the rows of the 'WHY THIS SKILL EXISTS' table that registration now covers. Do not run pan sync from the workspace: it distributes sync-sources/ from the installed package root (src/cli/commands/sync.ts:97), so it only picks this change up after merge and deploy.
